input.quote: Customer owes Fees only for conforming Services provided through the effective termination date, and Vendor shall promptly refund prepaid Fees allocable to the period after that date.
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum fee is payable by Customer anywhere in the Agreement, which meets the preferred position. Section 9.4 gives Customer convenience termination with payment limited to conforming Services rendered plus a refund of prepaid Fees; Section 27.3 confirms force-majeure termination is "without penalty"; and Section 7.3 bars interest on amounts ultimately found not due. The take-or-pay commitment in Section 2.1 is a minimum-commitment issue addressed under the MINCOMMIT rule rather than a liquidated-damages clause, so we do not flag it twice here.
